title: objective_answer
description: What one fresh verifier session returns when the owner or the decider chose to answer an objective as it stands, or approved an answer no verifier wrote (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 91): the objective's answer from what the run found. Code checks its numbers against the values at its res: locators and that every tag resolves, then writes it into research/objectives.json and as a Discussion passage.

objective.description: the objective you answered, by its id

answer.description: the answer, in a paragraph a reader of the Discussion can follow; every claim sentence ends with its {res:...} or {ref:...} tag, and every number in it is at one of its res: locators

question_limit.description: the one question you answered, restated in your own words
